chapter: Western University and Kansas City nightlife
title: Western band personnel and playing for Landon
summary: Lawrence Anderson and Buddy Anderson were in his band and later went to McShann; they played for Landon's campaign.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, yeah, but you were still at the college?
And you went in and heard this battle on Labor Day?
You said Buddy Anderson was in this band.
Buddy Anderson and Frog, Lawrence Anderson was in my band.
Frog was on trombone, and I got him with McShann. Both of them I got with McShann.
But we mostly rehearsed, we had one or two gigs in Kansas City, Kansas. We mostly just rehearsed; it was like an outlet for us.
Uh-huh. But then I had--took part of my band and played for Landon, when he had his political campaigns, you know. We got on a flat off that bottom truck with about four of us, you know.
